preconditions.description: THE LOAD-BEARING READINESS PRECONDITION. anchor_reachability.reference_source: live consummatory anchors this run: local_view_greedy=34.167, greedy_oracle=42.800 (the consummatory install band the BC demonstrator clones toward; usable floor 10.0)

interpretation_grid.label: substrate_not_ready_requeue
interpretation_grid.condition: an anchor is sub-floor, OR post_bc_foraging_competence fails the 10.0 USABLE install floor on a strict majority of seeds in either arm
interpretation_grid.reading: There is no usable installed prior to retain, so the run is UNINFORMATIVE about retention (this is exactly the 821 degenerate-install failure this re-run fixes). NEVER a retention verdict and never substrate_ceiling / does_not_support. Requeue (dose / install-mechanism work).

interpretation_grid.label: consummation_binding_retains_competence
interpretation_grid.condition: the extinguishing arm retains on a strict majority of seeds AND beats the non-extinguishing control's mean retained_fraction by the declared margin
interpretation_grid.reading: 781's drive-side null WAS a consummatory-act artefact: an approach drive that extinguishes on contact and hands off to CONSUME does not suppress foraging.

interpretation_grid.label: consummation_binding_succeeded_then_decayed
interpretation_grid.condition: the extinguishing arm's trajectory PEAK cleared the install floor on a strict majority of seeds, but its terminal retained_fraction fell below the retention floor
interpretation_grid.reading: The manipulation SUCCEEDED and then DECAYED -- a retention-DYNAMICS finding, not a null. Read the trajectory and the half-life, not the terminal scalar.

interpretation_grid.label: consummation_binding_eroded_under_both
interpretation_grid.condition: neither arm retains and their mean retained_fraction differ by less than the declared margin
interpretation_grid.reading: THE DECLARED NULL. The installed prior erodes identically whether or not the drive extinguishes -> the extinguish-and-hand-off binding is NOT the retention mechanism (H-consummation-binding eliminated). Does NOT weaken MECH-457 (diagnostic). Unlike 821, this reading is now made against a USABLE install (post_bc >= 10) so a null is a real erosion, not an install artefact.

interpretation_grid.label: consummation_binding_grid_nondiscriminative
interpretation_grid.condition: no arm passed its precondition gate, or the arms/anchors do not separate
interpretation_grid.reading: Not a refutation. Unscored; re-pose the measurement.

reuse_mint.note: Both boot arms are emitted reuse-ELIGIBLE with a declared config_slice and include_driver_script_in_hash=False, so a future consummatory-retention consumer can reuse the minted cells across a different driver. Distinct fingerprint from 821 (calibrated install dose 1200 vs 300). No separate baseline-only mint job.

load_bearing_dv: The post-installation competence TRAJECTORY (not terminal competence) of a CALIBRATED-DOSE (n_bc=1200) BC-installed raw_view policy across the reference RL refinement in the CONSUMMATORY env, probed every 250 episodes, under a NON-EXTINGUISHING vs an EXTINGUISHING appetitive approach drive. Statistic: retained_fraction = terminal trajectory competence / installed (post-BC) competence, with the trajectory PEAK and the de-confounded foraging RATE (resources/tick) read alongside it. PASS: the extinguishing arm holds retained_fraction >= 0.5 on a strict majority of seeds AND beats the non-extinguishing control's mean by >= 0.15. Readiness: post_bc_foraging_competence clears the 10.0 USABLE install floor on the worst seed of each arm (821 accepted 4.3 against a trivial 1.0 floor -> degenerate; calibration lands ~21-25).
notes: MECH-457 GOV-FANOUT-1 RETENTION leg 4 H-consummation-binding, CALIBRATED re-run superseding V3-EXQ-821a (crash-before-manifest, /diagnose-errors) which itself superseded V3-EXQ-821. Pre-registered under question 'competence_floor' in hypothesis_space_registry.v1.json (adjudicating_runs, Mode A existing-leg). DIAGNOSTIC (excluded from scoring); PROMOTES/DEMOTES NOTHING; route to /failure-autopsy. 821 FIX (carried unchanged from 821a): (1) BC install dose 300->1200 (calibrated 2026-08-08: 300->post_bc 3.1, 1200->25.05, 2400->21.05 saturated; the rare CONSUME action is under-cloned at low dose in the 6-action consummatory env, an install class-imbalance defect NOT a new mechanism); (2) USABLE install readiness floor 10.0 not the trivial 1.0 (821 accepted a 4.3 install and produced a degenerate two-arms-at-zero comparison); (3) foraging RATE (resources/tick) reported alongside the composite resources/episode, survival_horizon as a covariate (instrument audit 2026-08-07 sections 2/7; probe/install full-8-metric fix ree-v3 0550a2f). 821b FIX (this script): (4) assert_anchor_reachable's `threshold` is a FRACTION of reference cells (0.0-1.0), not the raw 10.0 install floor -- 821a passed the raw floor and crashed unconditionally at setup (AnchorUnreachable, exit 1, no manifest) despite both live anchors clearing the floor with margin; fixed via a dedicated POST_BC_ANCHOR_REACHABILITY_THRESHOLD=1.0 constant, matching sibling MECH-457 scripts 788/789/792/792a. MANIPULATION = the drive's EXTINCTION ONLY (approach_extinguishes_on_contact); consummatory env, approach drive, reference build and BC install dose IDENTICAL across arms. SUBSTRATE: mech457_consummatory_act + mech457_approach_extinction + consummatory_aware_reference_policies (all landed 2026-07-25, BUILT+VALIDATED). RE-DERIVE BRAKE: released -- diagnostic re-test of a currently-ALIVE leg (821's eliminated reading voided as an instrument artefact, audit sec 3d), upstream substrate built+validated, instrument fixed. growth_restriction: this is the sanctioned calibrated re-run of the one alive leg, not a new fan-out. GOV-REUSE-1: the decisive readout (retained_fraction of a USABLE-install consummatory-env approach-driven refinement with rate/tick) is recorded in NO manifest -- 821's install was degenerate and the consummatory action space is new as of 2026-07-25 -- so this must run.
